title: Reconstruct a possibly zero rank-one Gram from noisy quadratic powers
statement: For one fixed G=bb*,||G||<=1 and simultaneous scalar error<=delta,query n diagonals. If their maximumD<=4delta,return0 with error<=5n delta;otherwise reconstruct its pivot column from two quadrature queries per other coordinate and return qhat qhat*/D. The operator error is<=11n delta,uniformly including G=0.
